errors.evidence: The Y-axis in the figure has no label. The label "Инфлация" (Inflation) is hallucinated.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите е от 0.0 до 1.5
errors.evidence: The Y-axis range shown in the figure is from -0.5 to 1.5, not 0.0 to 1.5.

errors.text_span: стойността 0.0 се среща в началото и края на оста Y
errors.evidence: This is a confusing and incorrect description of the axis. The Y-axis starts at -0.5 and ends at 1.5. The value 0.0 is a tick mark in the middle, it does not appear at the beginning and end.

errors.text_span: Данните са представени с две линии.
errors.evidence: The figure contains three lines (one solid blue and two dotted red), not two.

errors.text_span: Първата, представена с червено, е плътна линия
errors.evidence: There is no red solid line. The solid line is blue, and the two red lines are dotted.

errors.text_span: показва стационарна стойност на приблизително 0.1 през целия период от време
errors.evidence: No line in the plot is stationary at 0.1. The solid blue line starts around 0.55 and decreases. The red lines are also not at 0.1.

errors.text_span: Втората линия е представена с червено и е пунктирана
errors.evidence: While there are two red dotted lines, the description has already incorrectly identified a non-existent red solid line as the 'first' line. It fails to distinguish between the two different red dotted lines.

errors.text_span: показва стойност на приблизително 0.0 през целия период от време
errors.evidence: Neither of the red dotted lines has a constant value of 0.0. One starts near 1.0 and increases, while the other starts near 0.0 and decreases significantly into negative values.
The description fails to mention the existence of the solid blue line, which represents the main data trend (point estimate).
